name: shapeforms
description: Build tooling for the ShapeForms WordPress plugin (dev-only; not part of the shipped plugin).
author: Shapekode

scripts.test:browser: node tests/browser/ai-loader.mjs && node tests/browser/start-cards.mjs && node tests/browser/build-settings-fixture.mjs && node tests/browser/ai-settings.mjs
scripts.makepot: wp i18n make-pot . languages/shapeforms.pot --exclude=build,node_modules,src,tests --slug=shapeforms && sed -i.bak '/POT-Creation-Date/d' languages/shapeforms.pot && rm -f languages/shapeforms.pot.bak
scripts.build: npm run makepot && wp-scripts plugin-zip && { zip -qd shapeforms.zip shapeforms/package.json shapeforms/README.md || true; } && rm -rf build && mkdir -p build && unzip -qo shapeforms.zip -d build && mv -f shapeforms.zip build/shapeforms-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.release: npm run makepot && { [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ] || { echo 'Working tree is not clean (commit the regenerated translation template if it changed) - commit or stash before releasing.'; exit 1; }; } && npm run build
